job.title: Administration Assistant
job.description:
Our SMEATON GRANGE client has been established for more than 20 years and are looking for an Administration Assistant to join their team.
You could be a more junior candidate who has completed an administration related traineeship or had 1-2 years of office experience and are ready for your next opportunity or even a parent returning to the workforce after a break.

We are looking for someone who will be reliable, with good communication skills, a great attitude, strong attention to detail and a willingness to learn the role from the ground up.

You would be working with a small, friendly, supportive, office-based team that look after the administration for the staff in the field.

This role will be varied and include answering calls, liaising with suppliers, subcontractors and clients as well as a varied range of admin related tasks to support the team including:
  • Accurate typing of detailed reports
  • Data Entry and updating and maintaining of internal systems
  • Managing site and project related paperwork
  • Day to day use of Outlook, Word, Excel, Google Drive; and a willingness to learn other systems
  • Creating of company newsletters and CANVA type documents and reports (this can be learnt, though basic knowledge of CANVA would be an advantage)
  • Placing and following up on purchase orders
  • Document control and filing
  • Coordinating staff uniforms
  • Assist with planning events
  • Some errands including collecting mail from local PO Box and pick up and drop off of supplies, uniforms etc when required.

This role is a full time role, working Monday to Friday 8.30am - 4.30pm in our client's SMEATON GRANGE offices, with parking on-site. Drivers licence and own transport is essential.

Interested? If you have relevant experience, we'd love to hear from you. Simply APPLY NOW!
﻿
Candidates living around MOUNT ANNAN, NARELLAN, SMEATON GRANGE, CAMDEN, ORAN PARK, GREGORY HILLS, LEPPINGTON or surrounds will find this role within an easy drive.

job.title: Temp Admin & Customer Service Professional
job.description:
We are looking for a well-presented Administration and Customer Service professional to work in our client’s sales office from Saturday through to Wednesday each week for this 3 week temp assignment.

This is a front of house role where you would be welcoming and assisting visitors to the sales office as well as undertaking varied administration duties to support the team.

Responsibilities would include -
  • Welcoming and assisting visitors to the sales centre
  • General administration and sales centre support
  • Responding to general enquiries
  • Maintaining the presentation and day-to-day operation of the sales centre
  • Assisting Sales team with varied Administration duties including updating and maintaining databases, emails, typing, data entry etc.

Important: This role is working Saturday, Sunday, Monday, Tuesday & Wednesday through the course of the assignment, so you must be available to work Saturdays and Sundays for weekends commencing from Saturday 12 September through to Sunday 04 October 2026.

There is also potential for some further weekend work down the track to cover planned leave periods.  
Professional presentation, a good customer service manner and sound admin skills are essential. A certificate of registration and prior experience in Real Estate, Display Homes, Land Sales or related type offices would be an advantage.
If you have relevant experience and would be interested in committing to this assignment we would love to hear from you. Simply APPLY NOW!

job.title: Looking for your next Office-based role?
job.description:

Whether you are actively searching for a new position or simply interested in hearing about roles that may suit your skills and career goals, we'd love to hear from you.

We recruit for a variety of office-based positions, including:

  • Reception
  • Administration Assistants
  • Customer Service
  • Data Entry
  • Executive Assistants & Personal Assistants
  • Internal Sales & Sales Support
  • Receptionists
  • Sales Coordinators
  • Accounts Payable & Accounts Receivable
  • Assistant Accountants
  • Accountants
  • Finance Managers

Our clients range from small family-owned businesses through to large national and multinational organisations, all located within the Camden, Campbelltown, Liverpool and surrounding regions.

Why Register with us?
  • Access opportunities that may not be advertised publicly
  • Be considered for temporary, permanent, contract and part-time roles
  • We specialise in recruiting local roles only
  • Work with an experienced recruiter with 30 years of local experience
  • Find opportunities closer to home, helping reduce travel time and improve work-life balance
  • Gain access to a broad network of employers across the local area

If you have a minimum of three years' experience in an office-based role and are looking for your next opportunity, we encourage you to register your interest today.

Upload your resume and a brief cover letter, or email Rachel directly: rachel@camdenvalleyrecruitment.com.au to confidentially discuss your career goals.
